assessment_summary: I validated the installation by (1) inspecting the deployment artifacts in /workspace (tika.yml compose file and taki-config.yaml, both matching the guide), (2) confirming the running container workspace-tika-1 from image codeberg.org/kosmos-eu/open_taki:latest is up on host port 9998 with the config bind-mounted read-only and byte-identical to the host file, and (3) exercising the documented runtime behavior over HTTP. The guide's own verification steps passed: GET / returns HTTP 200 with the documented JSON (name open_taki, version 0.9.0, status ok, feature flags incl. office/pdf/taki_v2), and GET /version returns 'open_taki 0.9.0'. I then performed real extraction tests using genuine documents: a two-page PDF generated in-container with PyMuPDF was extracted via pdftotext_partial, a DOCX generated with the container's pandoc was extracted via pandoc, HTML via pandoc, an RFC822 email via the built-in email method, and plain text via passthrough — all HTTP 200 with Tika-style JSON. A v2-protocol request (X-Taki-Protocol: v2, X-Taki-Features, X-Taki-Source-Ref) returned the extended response including X-TAKI:routing, confirming the auto-detected v2 path. Startup logs show 'open_taki 0.9.0 starting on :9998'. Limitations: the guide cites version 0.7.0 while the :latest image is 0.9.0 (newer, still exposing the same endpoints); optional external backends (LLM, Collabora, Whisper, embedding) are not provisioned, so their calls fail as expected but do not affect the documented core Tika-compatible extraction (the guide lists these as optional/external); ffmpeg is absent so video transcription would not work, consistent with the optional whisper/video path. An initial PDF test using a host-generated file failed only because the host lacked ps2pdf (no PDF was actually created), so I regenerated a valid PDF using the container's PyMuPDF and confirmed successful extraction. These limitations do not indicate an incomplete or broken core installation. Overall, objective behavioral evidence demonstrates the software is installed completely and is operational per the supplied guide.
